overview.title: Security that protects your business and unlocks enterprise sales.
overview.description: Security cannot be an afterthought. Teams that treat it as a pre-launch checkbox often discover architectural vulnerabilities too late — during audits, penetration tests, or worse, after a breach. Forgeone embeds data protection, access controls, and compliance into your development process from sprint one. We help you meet SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI requirements while building systems your engineering team can maintain and your sales team can confidently sell to enterprise customers.
highlights: Security architecture review and threat modeling
Encryption at rest and in transit for sensitive data
Role-based access control and identity management
Compliance readiness for SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS
DevSecOps integration — automated scanning in CI/CD pipelines

items.question: When should we start thinking about security?
items.answer: From day one. Security decisions made during architecture — data classification, access models, encryption strategy — are exponentially cheaper than retrofitting them before an audit or after an incident.

items.question: Can you help us achieve SOC 2 or HIPAA compliance?
items.answer: Yes. We conduct gap assessments against your target framework, implement required controls, prepare documentation, and support you through the audit process. We have guided clients through SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance successfully.

items.question: Does security slow down development?
items.answer: Not when done correctly. DevSecOps practices — automated scanning, pre-approved security patterns, and threat modeling during design — catch issues early when they are cheap to fix. Security becomes a enabler of faster enterprise sales, not a development bottleneck.

items.question: Do you perform penetration testing?
items.answer: Yes. We conduct application and infrastructure penetration tests with detailed findings reports and prioritized remediation guidance. We also help your team fix identified vulnerabilities and retest to confirm resolution.

items.question: How do you handle security for cloud environments?
items.answer: We implement cloud security best practices: IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, and logging. We follow the shared responsibility model and ensure your team understands which security controls are your responsibility versus the cloud provider's.
